patch.title: 在脚注中如实注明采访来源与时间线来源记录的日期不一致（3 月 12 日 vs 3 月 13 日）

hunks.oldText: \textsuperscript{1} The interview and timeline are both retained as sources.

\textsuperscript{1} The interview and timeline are both retained as sources.
